    1. foldLeft(B, BiFunction)

Schnittstelle FoldableLeft<A>

Typparameter:
A - the element type being folded
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Foldable<A>
public interface FoldableLeft<A>

Defines a left‑associative fold over a data structure.

The fold starts from an initial accumulator and applies the given function from left to right across the elements.

Contract: the accumulator, elements, and the folding function must not be null, and the folding function must not return null.

Seit:

  • Methodendetails

    • foldLeft

      <B> @NonNull B foldLeft(@NonNull B init, @NonNull BiFunction<? super B, ? super A, ? extends B> function)

      Folds the elements from left to right using an initial value and a binary function.

      The fold begins with init and iteratively applies function to the current accumulator and each element in encounter order.

      Typparameter:
      B - the accumulator/result type
      Parameter:
      init - the initial accumulator value; must not be null
      function - the folding function combining the previous accumulator and the current element; must not return null
      Gibt zurück:
      the accumulated result of the fold (never null)
      Seit:
      1.0.0
